htn_kidney.title: Inflammatory factors and hypertensive nephropathy: A bidirectional 2-sample Mendelian randomization study.
htn_kidney.authors: Yang Y, Xue J, Wang L
htn_kidney.zhSummary: 该文聚焦高血压肾病，属于临床研究。核心观点：利用来自大型公开人群队列的全基因组关联研究数据，我们应用双向 2 样本孟德尔随机化方法来研究 91 种炎症因素是否影响高血压风险。 临床提示：高血压肾病（HTN）是全球主要的公共卫生问题。
htn_kidney.abstract: Hypertensive nephropathy (HTN) is a major public health concern worldwide. This study aims to investigate the potential causal relationships between inflammatory factors and HTN, as well as to identify possible underlying biological pathways. Using genome-wide association study data from large publicly available population cohorts, we applied a bidirectional 2-sample Mendelian randomization approach to investigate whether 91 inflammatory factors influence the risk of HTN. Additionally, we examined whether HTN has a potential causal effect on the levels of these inflammatory factors. portal_hypertension.title: The Link of Portal-Hypertensive Gastropathy to Anaemia, Systemic Inflammation and Disease Progression in Cirrhosis.
portal_hypertension.journal: Liver international : official journal of the International Association for the Study of the Liver
portal_hypertension.authors: Pfisterer N, Lie-Ungurean I, Maurer J
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：门静脉高压性胃病（PHG）被认为是晚期慢性肝病（ACLD）患者慢性出血和贫血的潜在原因，并且可能代表与门脉高压相关的肠肝轴受损的内镜反射。 临床提示：门脉高压性胃病 (PHG) 被认为是晚期慢性肝病 (ACLD) 患者慢性出血和贫血的潜在原因，并且可能代表肠道受损的内镜反映
portal_hypertension.abstract: Portal-hypertensive gastropathy (PHG) is considered a potential cause of chronic bleeding and anaemia in patients with advanced chronic liver disease (ACLD) and might represent an endoscopic reflection of an impaired gut-liver axis associated with portal hypertension. The clinical significance of PHG in patients with ACLD undergoing routine endoscopies remains understudied. PHG was classified as absent, mild, or severe in prospectively recruited ACLD patients undergoing routine endoscopy (i.e., variceal screening) in the absence of acute bleeding between Q2/2017-Q3/2023. portal_hypertension.title: Development and external validation of a novel online calculator for predicting long-term survival following radical hepatectomy in patients with BCLC stage 0/A hepatocellular carcinoma and clinically significant portal hypertension.
portal_hypertension.journal: European journal of surgical oncology : the journal of the European Society of Surgical Oncology and the British Association of Surgical Oncology
portal_hypertension.studyType: Journal Article / Validation Study / Multicenter Study
portal_hypertension.authors: Shao T, Hu H, Li Y
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于多中心临床研究。核心观点：肝细胞癌 (HCC) 和有临床意义的门脉高压 (CSPH) 患者在肝切除术 (Hx) 后预后较差。 临床提示：本研究旨在开发一种计算器来估计队列的生存结果。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Patients with hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and clinically significant portal hypertension (CSPH) experience a poorer prognosis following hepatectomy (Hx). This study aimed to develop a calculator to estimate the survival outcomes of the cohort. This study collected data from patients with BCLC stage 0/A HCC and CSPH who underwent curative Hx at 12 medical centers between 2015 and 2020. Prognostic factors for overall survival (OS) were identified using the Cox proportional hazards model. portal_hypertension.title: Carvedilol triggers ferroptosis in hepatic stellate cells via the ATF4/SAT1 axis promoting spermidine depletion to ameliorate liver fibrosis.
portal_hypertension.authors: Xia Y, Wang S, Zhu J
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：肝纤维化是慢性肝损伤的主要病理后果，而卡维地洛是一种有效降低门脉高压的药物，最近的研究已显示其具有抗纤维化作用，但其确切的分子机制尚不清楚。 临床提示：肝纤维化是慢性肝损伤的主要病理后果，而卡维地洛作为一种有效降低门脉高压的药物，近年来的研究已显示其具有抗纤维化作用，但其临床应用尚不明确。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Liver fibrosis is a major pathological consequence of chronic liver injury, and carvedilol, a drug effective in reducing portal hypertension, has been shown to exert anti-fibrotic effects in recent studies, yet the precise molecular mechanism underlying this activity remains elusive. This study aimed to investigate the core scientific question of whether carvedilol alleviates liver fibrosis by inducing ferroptosis in hepatic stellate cells (HSCs) and to clarify the corresponding regulatory mechanisms.
